youtube.aciklama: Mismatch negativity (MMN) is the negativity at about 100 to 250 milliseconds in the difference wave, obtained by subtracting the response to the standard sound from the response to a rare, different deviant sound inserted among frequent ones. Its most important feature is that it needs no attention; it can be recorded while the person watches a silent film, and it has been recorded even in newborns.
